classification.difficultyReason: Differentiate a supplied cubic, classify its stationary points using the second derivative and interpret the local maximum in monetary units.

content.prompt: A company finds that the function $f(x)=x^3-96x^2+2880x$ provides a good approximation for their profit $f(x)$ in dollars, where $x$ is the advertising expenditure in thousands of dollars.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What expenditure on advertising would produce a local maximum profit?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}f'(x)&=3x^2-192x+2880.\end{align*}$$
Stationary points occur when $f'(x)=0$:
$$\begin{align*}3x^2-192x+2880&=0\\x^2-64x+960&=0\\(x-24)(x-40)&=0\\x&=24\text{ or }x=40.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}f''(x)&=6x-192\\f''(24)&=-48<0\\f''(40)&=48>0.\end{align*}$$
Thus $x=24$ gives a local maximum and $x=40$ gives a local minimum. The advertising expenditure for the local maximum is $\$24\,000$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is this local maximum profit?
